name: Ivf
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity in His image as male and female, commanding them to be fruitful and multiply, emphasizing the divine blessing and purpose of procreation (Genesis 1:27-28). The Bible acknowledges the challenge of barrenness but highlights God's power to open the womb, as seen in the prayers and promises given to barren women like Rebekah and the woman visited by the angel of the Lord (Genesis 25:21; Judges 13:3). Children are portrayed as a heritage and reward from the Lord, affirming the sacredness of life and God's sovereign role in the gift of offspring (Psalms 113:9; 127:3).
